title: Craft-lytra
description: Wait, That's Craftable Elytra?! A custom pack made for Tackle4826 that finally allows you to craft an Elytra.
body:
# Craft-lytra Wait, That's Craftable Elytra?! "Elytra is uncraftable! Stop watching so many other channels." This pack was created specifically for Tackle4826 because today... Elytra is finally craftable!!! (Well, if you install this Datapack). 🪽Main Feature Adds a crafting recipe for the Elytra. (Yep, literally just that.) Play on any version: Available for download as both a Datapack (Java Edition) and an Add-on (Bedrock Edition). Whether you are on PC or mobile, everyone gets to craft Elytra!!! How to Craft: Requires Phantom Membrane x4, Leather x4, Nether Star x1
![elytra-recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MineGarp/Craft-lytra/refs/heads/main/images/elytra_crafting_recipe.png) 📦 How to Install Choose the installation method based on the version you play: ☕ Java Edition (Datapack) Download the file and drop it into your world's datapacks folder. Type the /reload command or rejoin the world. 📱 Bedrock Edition (Add-on) Download the .mcpack file and open it to install it into the game. Go to your World Settings and enable it in the Behavior Packs tab. 📜 Credits & License
